subjects.title: NSS (Theory & Practice) – III (Leadership, Personality Development and Disaster Management)

units.title: Leadership and Personality Development (Theory)
units.topics: 1. Leadership qualities and role of youth in nation building 2. Communication skills and teamwork 3. Ethical values, social responsibility, and citizenship 4. Time management, stress management, and life skills

units.title: Disaster Management and Special Camp Activities (Practical)
units.topics: (A) Disaster Management: 1. Types of disasters – Natural and Man-made 2. Disaster preparedness, mitigation, and response 3. Basic first aid and emergency handling. (B) NSS Special Camp / Field Activities: 1. Village adoption and rural development activities 2. Health camps, literacy drives, and awareness programmes 3. Documentation and reporting of NSS activities
